import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path


def _run(cmd, timeout=240):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd='/app', text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout, check=False)


def test_preview_runtime_converges_and_backend_reloads():
    env_name = str(os.getenv('EDARSA_ENV') or os.getenv('APP_ENV') or os.getenv('ENVIRONMENT') or 'PREVIEW').upper()
    assert 'PROD' not in env_name, f'PRODUCTION_ENV_BLOCKED:{env_name}'

    apply = _run(['/app/tools/mirror_sync/apply_remote_update.sh'])
    assert apply.returncode == 0, 'SAFE_APPLY_FAILED\n' + apply.stdout[-4000:]

    local = _run(['git', '-C', '/app', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], timeout=30)
    remote = _run(['git', '-C', '/app', 'rev-parse', 'origin/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'], timeout=30)
    assert local.returncode == 0 and remote.returncode == 0
    assert local.stdout.strip() == remote.stdout.strip(), f'PREVIEW_HEAD_STILL_STALE:{local.stdout.strip()}!={remote.stdout.strip()}'

    route_path = Path('/app/backend/modules/inteligencia_comercial/iscam_routes.py')
    route = route_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    block = route.split('@iscam_router.get(\"/ventas-periodos\")', 1)[1].split('@iscam_router.get(\"/ventas-periodos/productos\")', 1)[0]
    assert 'dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime' in block
    assert 'dbo.Sync_Sales' not in block

    restart = _run(['supervisorctl', 'restart', 'backend'], timeout=60)
    assert restart.returncode == 0, 'BACKEND_RESTART_FAILED\n' + restart.stdout[-2000:]
    time.sleep(4)
    status = _run(['supervisorctl', 'status', 'backend'], timeout=30)
    assert status.returncode == 0
    assert ('RUNNING' in status.stdout or 'STARTING' in status.stdout), 'BACKEND_NOT_HEALTHY\n' + status.stdout[-2000:]
